question: LPG subsidy to domestic consumer under PAHAL Scheme is given by ____________ .

options.text: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PAHAL scheme:-**

 
 
• It is an initiative of the government of India to provide LPG cylinders to households at a subsidized rate.
 
• The subsidy is directly transferred to the bank account of the beneficiary under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme.
 
• The PAHAL scheme has helped in reducing the subsidy leakage and ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 
 
 

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs:-**

 
 
• It is responsible for the implementation of various schemes related to urban development, including the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY).
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Finance:-**
 
 
• It is responsible for the formulation and implementation of financial policies and regulations in the country.
 
 
 
• **The Ministry of Consumer Affairs:-**
 
 
• It is responsible for the protection of consumer rights and the implementation of various consumer welfare schemes.
